_comment: seal_reward canonical's start (FIXTURE-FIRST). 2026-07-26 Act V, the SKILL path: descent ask -> the runes -> [Detect Magic]'s QUARTET read -> re-cut the ward, consuming the piece of warded ruin-stone this save actually kept (the vault construct's core shard). Same Act V position as seal_open_start (see that fixture), plus three load-bearing differences: classes carry {necromancer: 1} for detect_magic (gained_by {studied_necromancy: 1}, banked here alongside its own precursor asked_about_necromancy -- Pisces taught this player the dead art); detected_wardwork is 3, the three OTHER shipped wardwork sites read (inn frame, ruin socket, the seam back in these halls), so the [Detect Magic] arm's richest text_variant is the one this run gets; and the pack holds construct_core_shard, NOT guardian_ward_fragment. FIX ROUND 1 (reviewer IMPORTANT): this is now deliberately a PLATES/WARDWORK-path save -- it never fought ruin_guardian (no cleared_ruin_guardian), so the only warded ruin-stone it owns is the vault construct's core, the main-line chance-1.0 drop every player carries. That is the exact state that had NO route to seal_rewarded before the second close arm landed, so this canonical proves the arm that matters: the fragment row renders VISIBLE-LOCKED here (item gates tease, they never hide -- only accomplishment gates hide), which the fork's option pin asserts, and the shard row is CONSUMED on the close. No fight is resolved on this route; rng_state is inert for outcomes. #438 BAND RE-DERIVATION (2026-08-13). Classes {warrior:5, mage:5, +1} -> {warrior:14, mage:9, +1}, and the loadout gains the leather_jerkin + hedge_ward_charm + hunters_fang_talisman this Act V position always implied. WHY: #440 made the Seal Warden a CHOKEPOINT on every path, including this one, but this fixture was authored for a NON-COMBAT ending and its build was never re-derived for the fight it inherited. Measured against the shipped warden with tests/_warden_probe.gd at 100 seeds, autoplay policy -- which is what this canonical actually runs -- the old build read 0.08 BEFORE #438's warden move and 0.03 after. Its green was a lucky seed, not a viable build: a 1-in-12 draw that #438 turned into a 1-in-33, and seeds 1-23 all lose. Pinning another fluke would re-create the defect, so the BUILD moved instead. The new build reads 0.40 autoplay / 0.71 competent, i.e. slightly ABOVE seal_open_start's own spellsword-14 read (0.34/0.70) -- this path is no longer the one that proves the finale is beatable at half band. CONSOLIDATION IS DELIBERATELY NOT TRIPPED: warrior 14 clears min_parent_level 10 but mage 9 does not, so no auto-merge fires and the three-class shape (and its class-gated dialogue leg) is preserved -- which is also the steel thread's own situation, where the mage half never reaches 10. Level counters move with the levels (melee_hit 18 -> 80, the top rung [Warrior]'s own table names, and spell_cast 13 -> 37 for [Mage] 9), so test_fixture_coherence still proves every held level was earned rather than granted.
